boundaries: Cost/Cast/FollowThrough/DisableOtherAbilities absent in custom CSV, instant execution and resource-not-deducted adapter; old-version external defaults do not prove custom map inheritance.
300 range and HP<=400/3000 are auto filters. Manual A14T may target air; manual primary targets have no script HP restriction.
A14T attacker and A14X damaged branches omit hidden predicate; native order may still reject. Keep select/attempt distinct.
A14X snapshots SelectRange before main damage; second filter does not recheck dead/Avul after main damage side effects.
99999 damage is not KillUnit. Main and independent damage listeners still apply, with weapon flag true from UnitDamageTargetBJ.
Return bypasses all digestion, A14W grant/removal, 5-second cooldown reset and trigger registration. No dynamic A14W runtime coverage added.
Native group enumeration, team mapping, dead state vs health threshold and flight/model visuals remain host adaptations.

A14T.name: 吞噬
A14T.ubertip: 科多兽随机吞噬半径300码内随机一名生命值低于400的敌人进入肚中消化，吞噬状态下被吞噬单位每秒损失30点生命值，每次吞噬最多持续10s。（吞噬状态结束后技能才会进入cd）（吞噬状态结束后如果目标没有死亡则会于原地吐出）吞噬状态下科多兽每秒额外恢复10点生命值。如果科多兽处于吞噬状态下死亡则肚中单位会以当前生命值状态逃出

A14X.name: 暴食
A14X.ubertip: 暴食科多兽比寻常的科多兽更加饥饿凶残。暴食科多兽随机吞噬半径300码内随机2名生命值低于3000的敌人进入肚中消化，吞噬状态下被吞噬单位每秒损失30+8%最大生命值，每次吞噬最多持续10s。（吞噬状态结束后技能才会进入cd）（吞噬状态结束后如果目标没有死亡则会于原地吐出）吞噬状态下科多兽每秒额外恢复30点生命值。如果暴食科多兽处于吞噬状态下死亡则肚中单位也会随之死亡。（技能无视魔免）（技能对空军单位无效）
